## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# 检查并加载 mouse-level 细胞比例统计和绘图所需包。
check_packages(c("Seurat", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "here"))

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths()
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "04_Mouse_Level_Proportion"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "04_Mouse_Level_Proportion"))
```

## Load annotated objects

```{r load}
# 读取 01/02 步骤输出的最终注释对象，并统一分组命名。
sc_spleen <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_annotated.rds"))
sc_bm <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "02_bonemarrow_annotated.rds"))
sc_spleen$Group <- normalize_group_levels(sc_spleen$Group)
sc_bm$Group <- normalize_group_levels(sc_bm$Group)
```

## Plot labels

```{r plot_labels}
# 设定图中重点展示的脾脏细胞类型，其余类型合并为 Other cells。
spleen_focus <- c(
  "Naive B cells", "Activated or transitional B cells", "Memory B cell-like",
  "Early GC or pre-GC B cells", "GC B cells", "Cycling B cells", "Plasma cell-like",
  "Naive CD4 T cells", "Central memory CD4 T cells", "Tfh cells",
  "Regulatory T cells", "Naive CD8 T cells", "Effector memory CD8 T cells",
  "NK cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "DC"
)

# 设定图中重点展示的骨髓细胞类型，其余类型合并为 Other cells。
bm_focus <- c(
  "Pre or pro B cells", "Naive or mature B cells", "Activated B cells",
  "Plasmablast-like", "Plasma cell-like",
  "T cells", "NK cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Granulocytes",
  "Neutrophils", "Eosinophils", "Basophils", "DC"
)

# CellType_Plot 用于简化展示，CellType_Fine 保留完整细胞类型。
sc_spleen$CellType_Plot <- ifelse(sc_spleen$CellType_Fine %in% spleen_focus, sc_spleen$CellType_Fine, "Other cells")
sc_bm$CellType_Plot <- ifelse(sc_bm$CellType_Fine %in% bm_focus, sc_bm$CellType_Fine, "Other cells")
```

## Mouse-level proportions

```{r proportions}
# 分别计算完整 fine label 和绘图合并标签的 mouse-level 细胞比例。
prop_spleen_full <- calc_mouse_proportions(sc_spleen, celltype_col = "CellType_Fine")
prop_bm_full <- calc_mouse_proportions(sc_bm, celltype_col = "CellType_Fine")

prop_spleen_plot <- calc_mouse_proportions(sc_spleen, celltype_col = "CellType_Plot")
prop_bm_plot <- calc_mouse_proportions(sc_bm, celltype_col = "CellType_Plot")

stats_spleen_full <- test_mouse_proportions(prop_spleen_full)
stats_bm_full <- test_mouse_proportions(prop_bm_full)
stats_spleen_plot <- test_mouse_proportions(prop_spleen_plot)
stats_bm_plot <- test_mouse_proportions(prop_bm_plot)

# 保存比例表和组间统计结果，后续作图和导出均使用这些表。
write.csv(prop_spleen_full, file.path(table_dir, "04_spleen_mouse_level_proportions_fine.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prop_bm_full, file.path(table_dir, "04_bm_mouse_level_proportions_fine.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prop_spleen_plot, file.path(table_dir, "04_spleen_mouse_level_proportions_plot_labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prop_bm_plot, file.path(table_dir, "04_bm_mouse_level_proportions_plot_labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stats_spleen_full, file.path(table_dir, "04_spleen_mouse_level_proportion_stats_fine.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stats_bm_full, file.path(table_dir, "04_bm_mouse_level_proportion_stats_fine.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stats_spleen_plot, file.path(table_dir, "04_spleen_mouse_level_proportion_stats_plot_labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stats_bm_plot, file.path(table_dir, "04_bm_mouse_level_proportion_stats_plot_labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Publication figures

```{r plotting_functions}
# 堆叠条形图展示每只 mouse 的整体细胞组成。
plot_stacked <- function(prop_df, title) {
  plot_df <- prop_df |>
    mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, levels = unique(CellType[order(CellType == "Other cells", CellType)])))
  pal <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(levels(plot_df$CellType)), "Dark 3"), levels(plot_df$CellType))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MouseID, y = Percentage, fill = CellType)) +
    geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    facet_grid(~Group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Cells (%)") +
    theme_publication() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

# 箱线图加散点展示每个细胞类型在两组 mouse 间的比例分布。
plot_mouse_dots <- function(prop_df, title) {
  ggplot(prop_df |> filter(CellType != "Other cells"), aes(x = Group, y = Percentage, color = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 1.8) +
    facet_wrap(~CellType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Control = "#2166AC", Experimental = "#B2182B")) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Cells (%)") +
    theme_publication() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
}

# 横向热图展示每只 mouse 中各细胞类型的比例。
plot_mouse_heatmap <- function(prop_df, title) {
  plot_df <- prop_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CellType = factor(CellType, levels = rev(unique(CellType[order(CellType == "Other cells", CellType)]))),
      MouseID = factor(MouseID, levels = unique(MouseID[order(Group, MouseID)]))
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MouseID, y = CellType, fill = Percentage)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(~Group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = grDevices::hcl.colors(9, "YlOrRd"), name = "Cells (%)") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_publication() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r spleen_figures, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
# 生成并保存脾脏细胞比例的条形图、箱线图和热图。
p_spleen_stack <- plot_stacked(prop_spleen_plot, "Spleen cell composition by mouse")
p_spleen_stats <- plot_mouse_dots(prop_spleen_plot, "Spleen cell proportions by mouse")
p_spleen_heatmap <- plot_mouse_heatmap(prop_spleen_plot, "Spleen cell proportion heatmap by mouse")

print(p_spleen_stack)
print(p_spleen_stats)
print(p_spleen_heatmap)

save_pub_plot(p_spleen_stack, "04_spleen_mouse_level_stacked_bar", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 6)
save_pub_plot(p_spleen_stats, "04_spleen_mouse_level_box_dots", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 8)
save_pub_plot(p_spleen_heatmap, "04_spleen_mouse_level_heatmap", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r bm_figures, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
# 生成并保存骨髓细胞比例的条形图、箱线图和热图。
p_bm_stack <- plot_stacked(prop_bm_plot, "Bone marrow cell composition by mouse")
p_bm_stats <- plot_mouse_dots(prop_bm_plot, "Bone marrow cell proportions by mouse")
p_bm_heatmap <- plot_mouse_heatmap(prop_bm_plot, "Bone marrow cell proportion heatmap by mouse")

print(p_bm_stack)
print(p_bm_stats)
print(p_bm_heatmap)

save_pub_plot(p_bm_stack, "04_bm_mouse_level_stacked_bar", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 6)
save_pub_plot(p_bm_stats, "04_bm_mouse_level_box_dots", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 8)
save_pub_plot(p_bm_heatmap, "04_bm_mouse_level_heatmap", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 6)
```
